newsitem.title: USA: Blackhawk Bancorp agrees to buy Rochelle.
newsitem.headline: Blackhawk Bancorp agrees to buy Rochelle.

text.p: Blackhawk Bancorp Inc said Friday it reached an agreement in principal to acquire Illinois-based Rochelle Bancorp Inc.
Under the agreement, Rochelle stockholders will receive $7.52 per share, subject to the company meeting certain conditions. Blackhawk said Rochelle has 554,875 shares outstanding.
The agreement is subject to Rochelle shareholder approval, due diligence and other regulatory approvals. Blackhawk said it expects to complete the transaction in the second quarter of 1997.
As part of the merger and agreed reorganization, Blackhawk said it will also acquire Midland Acceptance Corp, a finance subsidiary of Rochelle Bancorp.
In addition, Rochelle will proceed with the sale of Midland Financial Corp, a 50 percent-owned subsidiary mortgage company, to its principal stockholders.

"This merger creates a natural extension of our market across the state line into Illinois and also allows Blackhawk to leverage its excess capital in order to increase its return on equity," Dennis Conerton, president and chief executive of Blackhawk, said in a statement.
Rochelle has assets of about $48 million. Midland Acceptance has assets of about $2 million.
Blackhawk said that upon completion of the merger, it will have six bank offices and two finance locations with assets of about $200 million.
